mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST showed sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings increase.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 jobs within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past quarter signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer spending increase.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased over the past quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate monetary tightening and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL showed sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% within a month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 2% within a month.
